title: Cross-Spectrum Estimator
text: Estimate cross-power spectrum density, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Window function} sets Window function; {Window length source}, {Window length} sets the length of window in samples, {Window overlap (%)} sets the percentage of overlap between windows, {Averaging method}, {Specify forgetting factor from input port}, {Forgetting factor} sets the exponential weighting forgetting factor, {Number of spectral averages}, {FFT length source} sets the source of FFT length value, {FFT length}, {Sidelobe attenuation of window (dB)} sets the sidelobe attenuation of window in dB, {Frequency range}, {Inherit sample rate from input}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Window length source
params.values: Window length source Same as input frame length (default) | Specify on dialog

params.name: Window length
params.values: Length of window in samples 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Window overlap (%)
params.values: Percentage of overlap between windows 0 (default) | scalar in the range [ 0, 100 )

params.name: Specify forgetting factor from input port
params.values: Specify forgetting factor from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Forgetting factor
params.values: Exponential weighting forgetting factor 0.9 (default) | scalar in the range ( 0, 1 ]

params.name: Number of spectral averages
params.values: Number of spectral averages 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: FFT length source
params.values: Source of FFT length value Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Window function
params.values: Window function Hann (default) | Chebyshev | Flat Top | Hamming | Kaiser | Rectangular

params.name: Sidelobe attenuation of window (dB)
params.values: Sidelobe attenuation of window in dB 60 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency range
params.values: Frequency range of the cross-spectrum estimate Centered (default) | One-sided | Two-sided

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Inherit sample rate from input on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
